title: Uncertainty quantification for expectation-calibrated predictions
summary: The existing literature on model calibration focuses mainly on classification and probabilistic prediction. In this work, we address calibrated point predictions for the conditional mean. Although existing impossibility results preclude exact out-of-sample calibrated predictions, we develop calibrated confidence intervals that provide uncertainty quantification around such predictions. Our results come with distribution-free theoretical guarantees and are applicable in model-agnostic, finite-sample settings under exchangeability by leveraging conformal prediction.
